limitations: Generic 8-bit serial-in parallel-out register with separate positive-edge shift and output-latch clocks, active-low shift clear, active-low parallel output enable, and serial cascade output independent of output enable. limitations: Generic single H-bridge with IN1/IN2 and active-high ENABLE/PWM. Enabled 10 drives forward, 01 reverse, 00 brakes to GND and 11 brakes to VM; ENABLE low coasts.
